## RunEnv interface

What holds for the process: the stores and objects every call shares, how the deployment reads its sources, and how the application classifies errors and keeps time. `createRunner` takes it once; `run` takes it with each call's options (`RunOptions`<!-- -->). Every option has a default, so an empty env reads every connector, caches nothing and bounds nothing. README, "The runner", says why each option is here and not in `RunCall`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface RunEnv 
```
